verdict.rationale: The evidence shows SumUp supports in-person payments with Solo/Go readers and Tap to Pay. However, nothing documents the merchant sign-up, the approval process or its timing, or ordering hardware from a dashboard. The core of this story is a fast onboarding-to-hardware flow, and in-person payment capability alone does not evidence that.

support.subject: As a founder, I can sign up, get approved, and order hardware from the dashboard so I am taking in-person payments the same week
